slides.title: Reasons I keep my cleaning company's insurance current
The client asked.
slides.body: Office building. New contract. "Can you send your COI?"

slides.title: The client asked.
slides.body: Property manager. Before the first move-out clean.

slides.title: The client asked.
slides.body: Medical office. Before we were even allowed past the front desk.

slides.title: The client asked.
slides.body: Same office building. New policy year. Asked again.

slides.title: Also, the client asked.
slides.body: Different client. Same certificate. Not the date I thought it was.

slides.title: Commercial clients often want a current certificate before you start. And again after it renews.
slides.body: Save this so you check the date before they do.
